name: @sos-2/tests-autonomous-build
description: SOS 2.0 Autonomous-Build Dogfood Suites (Work Order P15, lane B): the journeys where the system works WITHOUT the user babysitting it, driven end-to-end over the merged public surfaces only (reference adapters/bodies/executors; no new product code). Pinned journeys: the §11 flagship greenfield journey driven to evidence-backed completion with NO user-online tick after kick-off (completion granted ONLY by the independent evaluation suite — the acting body's self-certification is a typed INDEPENDENCE_DENIED, pinned); continuous observation while NO body is active (events still ingest, stale/UNKNOWN stays truthful, nothing fabricates progress); anomaly -> summoned body through the action surface -> evidence-gated repair; body interruption -> replacement -> resume from durable checkpoints WITHOUT losing semantic identity; provider outage -> honest UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN with no fabricated progress -> re-plan on capacity return -> completion, the outage window visible in the timeline and the evidence-only cost ledger; user computer offline during cloud execution (cloud ticks advance; the disconnected-user timeline replays on return with exact revisions and retained uncertainty). Structural pins: zero new external dependencies (workspace:* + the existing toolchain only), offline determinism (no ambient time/randomness/network/process/timers in owned sources), fixed vitest seed 424242, only merged + P15-lane-B-relevant workspace imports, evidence records + Architecture Delta validated in-test against the frozen schema.
